name: sub2api-gateway-cache-benchmark
description: Ten fixed OpenAI-compatible chat completion samples for gateway cache benchmarking.

samples.description: Short deterministic translation with a compact system prompt.

messages.content: You are a precise translation assistant. Return only the translated sentence.
Translate to English: 这个接口需要稳定地复用缓存。

samples.description: Short classification request with structured output.

messages.content: Classify support tickets. Return JSON with category, urgency, and one_sentence_reason.
Customer says the API key was rotated yesterday and all production requests now receive 401.

samples.description: Short tool-enabled task with one compact function schema.

function.name: get_weather
function.description: Fetch current weather for a city.

messages.content: Use tools when fresh data is required. Keep responses short.
Do I need an umbrella in Shanghai today?

samples.description: Short operational tool task with deterministic schema overhead.

function.name: lookup_customer_plan
function.description: Return the customer plan and current support tier.

function.name: create_incident_note
function.description: Attach a triage note to an incident.

messages.content: You triage support incidents and call tools only when needed.
Incident INC-2042 from customer cus_abc says cache headers disappeared after deploy.

samples.description: Longer code review style task with stable instructions and repeated diff context.

messages.content: You are a senior backend reviewer. Focus on correctness, concurrency, observability, and test coverage. Return a concise ordered list of findings. Do not rewrite code unless asked.

samples.description: Policy summarization request with large stable prompt and JSON output.

messages.content: You are an internal governance assistant. Summaries must be neutral, audit-friendly, and specific. JSON keys: decision, risk_level, required_controls, open_questions.

Summarize the cache rollout policy. Exact response cache is opt-in by API key and group. Semantic cache is experimental and requires tenant isolation, model isolation, tool schema filtering, similarity threshold, audit logs, and a fast rollback switch. Provider prompt cache routing may be enabled by default when it preserves account pool permissions and does not leak tenant data.

samples.description: Coding-agent style request with multiple stable tool schemas.

function.name: search_code
function.description: Search repository files using ripgrep-like syntax.

function.name: run_tests
function.description: Run a test command and return stdout, stderr, and exit code.

messages.content: You are a careful coding agent. Prefer reading tests before editing. Explain only the next concrete action.
Find where gateway cache metrics should be recorded and propose the minimal test-first change.

samples.description: RAG-style tool request with stable retrieval schema and long context.

function.name: search_docs
function.description: Search product documentation by query and section.

messages.content: Answer from product docs. Cite section names when available. If context is insufficient, say what to retrieve.

Known docs context: Gateway response caching stores full model responses and must include request body, model, provider, endpoint, tenant namespace, tools, tool_choice, response_format, temperature, top_p, seed, and stream mode in its key. Provider prompt caching is separate and should report cached input tokens. Explain the difference for an admin user.

samples.description: Analysis planning task with SQL and chart tool schemas.

function.name: render_metric_chart
function.description: Render a dashboard chart from named metrics.

messages.content: You are an analytics engineer. Plan the smallest set of metric queries needed before making a dashboard claim.
We need to show cache hit rate, saved tokens, saved cost, upstream call reduction, p50 duration, and first-token latency for baseline versus LiteLLM proxy over ten fixed samples.

samples.description: Streaming control sample. It validates stream parsing and may be excluded from cache-hit targets if a proxy bypasses streaming cache.

messages.content: Summarize operational notes in one sentence.
Exact cache should be tested separately from streaming replay because many gateways only store a stream after all chunks complete.
